# InnerAura Labs

> InnerAura Labs builds HyperWeave, an open-source visual artifact compiler for AI agents. Structured agent output compiles into deterministic diagrams, tables, and charts that people can see and agents can read back, change, and verify.

Agents supply structure, not coordinates. HyperWeave measures the content, picks a layout, and draws the connections. Identical input produces identical output.

Each artifact carries its own spec, so agents can read it back, diff it, and verify it instead of redrawing from scratch. One source renders as SVG (self-contained, no JavaScript, embeds in READMEs and docs like any image), ANSI for terminals, or PNG/WebP.

Makes diagrams (twelve types, including pipelines, DAGs, trees, sequence diagrams, and state machines), tables, and charts. Interfaces: MCP server, CLI, HTTP API, and Agent Skill.

## HyperWeave

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/InnerAura/hyperweave/main/README.md): install, usage, and every artifact type
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/InnerAura/hyperweave): source and examples
- [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/hyperweave/): `pip install hyperweave`
